comfyTransformers.reason: The reviewed LTX-2 runtime excludes Transformers 5.15 because its Gemma support regressed. The worker verifies this exact 5.14 patch after installing the open-ended ComfyUI requirements.

kornia.reason: The pinned LTX custom node imports pyramid.pad, which is absent from Kornia 0.8.3. The worker build verifies this import before an image can be published.

latentSync.reason: The pinned upstream setup declares Python 3.10.13, so the worker uses the maintained Python 3.10 line; its mediapipe 0.10.11 dependency has no Python 3.12 wheel.

requiredBeforeQualification: Build the worker image and record its immutable sha256 digest.
Review every model license and record every downloaded model-file hash.
Export API-format ComfyUI workflows and record their exact hashes.
Run the one-GPU smoke, security, recovery, runtime, VRAM, quality, and cost benchmark pack.
Promote only the passing candidate into config/workflow-pack.production.json.
